spiritgiven.comments: Contact in the end zone was a bit more than we are comfortable with. Some incorrect hand signals. But overall a great game, great communication, we had fun! Thanks Canada
A bit more consideration for other teams perspective on calls would be good. Ensuring off field perspectives are kept minimal would be nice.

Thank you GB for a competitive game. A few comments on inconsistent levels of contact acceptance within the team, and overall positive attitude was great but self-control could be improved from people both on the field and the sideline. But overall we really enjoyed the game. Thank you for your discussions and we will work on those points going forward.

spiritreceived.comments: We had a close call for one of our players who was going up line and got clipped. He was scared due to a previous injury and emotions were increased. The other player did well keeping calm and our team recognized his attempt to pull up and avoid a dangerous play.
Thank you very much for your kind communication. We look forward to seeing you again.

Many comments made on the side line weren’t made in a good spirit of the game. Many of our players and coaches felt that many Australian players were trying to persuaded our calls into their advantage

Thanks for discussing with us the things we felt could be improved - our concerns were based on the second half of the game: awareness to avoid dangerous play, disregarding observers opinions without a good reason/argument, jumping in too early to give suggestions, comments and observations about play from the sideline. Aside from that we had a great time with you on the sideline and with those few things resolved we're looking forward to meet you again in the future for another fantastic game

Thank you Australia for a great game. We felt you had a lot of really great positivity on the sidelines. We can appreciate that we may have had a lower tolerance of contact as other teams, however it is a non-contact sport so you should come out avoiding body contact irrespective of a teams tolerance level. Thank you for cleaning it up in the second half. Thanks Mel for the awesome spirit prizes and great sideline chat!
It was a very spirited game. There were some calls but mostly resolved on the field
Thank you Australia for such a wonderful game to close the tournament! We hope to play you again!
